description: n=4 q-character sign sweep — testing the sharpened (M1) conjecture in MetallicPiecewise.lean that the metallic-piecewise structure appears at strand count n ≥ 4 where the partition lattice is richer than n=3.  4 braid words × 5 partitions of 4 = 20 (β,λ) pairs swept across the same metallic intervals as the earlier probes.
limitations: Only the 4-braid-word subset {e, σ_1, σ_3, σ_1 σ_3} is tested.  σ_1 σ_3 commute on B_4 (disjoint strands), so this is the easiest non-trivial case.  Non-commuting words like σ_1 σ_2 σ_3 (full cycle) would require explicit Hoefsmit-Wenzl matrix arithmetic in each rep — deferred.

Characters for the (3,1) and (2,1,1) reps on σ_i use the standard A_λ + B_λ = dim λ formula; this is exact for single generators and the disjoint-product factorisation is exact for the (2,2) rep where σ_1, σ_3 simultaneously diagonalise.  Other reps may have small approximation error from the factorisation.
